features.name: v1_v2_euclidean_distance_to_origin
features.description: Calculates the Euclidean distance to the origin in the V1-V2 feature space, providing a magnitude measure for the first two components.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves KNN performance by providing a composite magnitude feature that captures the joint scale of V1 and V2.

features.name: v3_v4_v5_magnitude
features.description: Computes the vector magnitude of the higher-order features V3, V4, and V5.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps distance-based models group similar instances by summarizing the energy in the higher-order feature dimensions.

features.name: v1_normalized
features.description: Standardizes V1 using its training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures V1 contributes proportionally to distance calculations without dominating due to scale differences.

features.name: v2_normalized
features.description: Standardizes V2 using its training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures V2 contributes proportionally to distance calculations without dominating due to scale differences.

features.name: v1_v2_ratio
features.description: Calculates the ratio of V1 to V2, clipped to a reasonable range to handle near-zero denominators.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the relative proportion between the first two features, which can define distinct clusters in the feature space.

features.name: total_energy
features.description: Calculates the sum of squared values across all five features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single scalar summary of the overall signal strength, useful for separating high-energy from low-energy instances.

features.name: distance_to_global_mean
features.description: Calculates the Euclidean distance from the instance to the global mean of the training dataset across all five features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as an unsupervised prototype distance, helping KNN identify outliers or central instances.

features.name: max_feature_value
features.description: Extracts the maximum value across all five features for a given instance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the peak intensity of the feature set, which can be a strong distinguishing characteristic for neighborhood formation.

features.name: min_feature_value
features.description: Extracts the minimum value across all five features for a given instance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the lowest intensity of the feature set, providing a boundary characteristic for distance metrics.

features.name: v1_v2_v3_centroid_distance
features.description: Calculates the Euclidean distance to the centroid of the first three features based on training set means.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a localized prototype distance focusing on the primary features, improving sub-space neighborhood geometry.

features.name: spectral_shape_judgment
features.description: A semantic assessment of the overall shape of the feature sequence V1 through V5, scoring how closely it resembles a typical harmonic structure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Injects domain-like structural understanding into the feature space, allowing KNN to group instances with similar underlying patterns.

features.name: outlier_score_judgment
features.description: Evaluates the likelihood that the row represents an anomalous or noisy measurement based on the combination of V1 to V5.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps distance-based models isolate noisy points, preventing them from corrupting the neighborhoods of typical instances.
